info.name: HoneBill Phase 2 through Phase 6
info.description: Postman requests for HoneBill Phases 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Phase 4 engine requests require SEP-10 auth or an Ed25519 signed intent as indicated; preparation routes return unsigned XDR and do not broadcast.

request.description: Sends or returns a test-mode OTP according to backend configuration. This can contact configured SMS providers; do not use it for production numbers without authorization.
Verify the OTP first, then copy the returned verificationToken into the verificationToken collection variable before registration.

Checks whether a normalized phone number is registered.

item.name: Backend Health (deep)
item.description: Readiness checks plus TextBee primary/fallback device status. Deep checks may contact the configured TextBee API.

item.name: SMS Webhook Health
item.description: Returns non-secret SMS webhook configuration metadata; does not send an SMS.

item.name: SEP-24 Info
item.description: Public discovery of supported assets, deposit/withdraw availability, and configured limits.

item.name: SEP-24 Transaction Lookup
item.description: Looks up a transaction owned by the account identified by the SEP-10 bearer token.

item.name: Initiate Deposit (interactive)
item.description: Creates an incomplete deposit transaction and returns a short-lived interactive URL. Requires a valid SEP-10 token; creates a database record.

item.name: Initiate Withdrawal (interactive)
item.description: Creates an incomplete withdrawal transaction and returns a short-lived interactive URL. Requires a valid SEP-10 token; creates a database record.

item.name: Prepare Online Transfer
item.description: Requires an Ed25519 signed-intent bearer signature matching transfer:v2:online:<token>:<sender>:<recipient>:<amount>. Returns unsigned transaction XDR for wallet signing; it does not broadcast.

item.name: Prepare Deposit
item.description: Requires an Ed25519 signed-intent signature for the deposit. Returns unsigned XDR for wallet signing; it does not broadcast.

item.name: Prepare Withdrawal
item.description: Requires an Ed25519 signed-intent signature for the withdrawal. Returns unsigned XDR for wallet signing; it does not broadcast.

item.name: Prepare Offline Key Rotation
item.description: Requires SEP-10 authentication. Checks whether the offline key needs rotation and may return unsigned XDR.

item.name: Confirm Offline Key Rotation
item.description: Requires SEP-10 authentication and should be sent only after the rotation transaction is submitted on-chain.

item.name: Register Recipient
item.description: Requires SEP-10 authentication. May submit an on-chain recipient registration through the configured registrar; use only when you intend to register the recipient.
